upstream_reachability.http: curl -L https://azure.microsoft.com/ -> HTTP 200, final URL https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us, edge IP 23.0.194.168
upstream_reachability.conclusion: the declared upstream is live and reachable, so the mirror is a real capture; no fixture fallback was used

capture_method: direct HTTP GETs (curl, Chrome UA) against the live HTML pages, plus the public JSON endpoints the live pricing calculator and the customer-stories hub load (same versioned feeds the pages use); no headless browser and no WAF bypass were needed

azure.microsoft.com.role: primary site: home, products catalog (138 products across 21 categories), 23 captured product pages, pricing hub (50 cards), 4 pricing-details pages (AKS, Linux VMs, Cosmos DB, Managed Disks), free-services feed (85 services), Azure blog (21 posts), cloud-computing dictionary (86 articles), geographies and support pages

azure.microsoft.com pricing calculator s.role: the versioned JSON the live calculator loads: virtual machines (46,781-SKU feed, 62 regions), kubernetes service (control-plane tiers + node sizes), storage (graduated block-blob tiers), cosmos db (provisioned / serverless / gateway), region list (31 geographies) and 24 currencies
azure.microsoft.com pricing calculator s.curation: the tracked calculator.json keeps a real subset: 55 VM sizes (Linux + Windows, 2,943 regional per-hour prices), 22 AKS node sizes plus all 5 control-plane tiers, 11 storage SKUs including every graduated tier, and 12 Cosmos DB SKUs — every price value is captured verbatim; the full 62 MB VM feed stays in scraped_data/ (gitignored)

customers.microsoft.com.role: customer-stories search API (filters product:azure) and every story page: 142 stories with industries, products, quotes, challenge/solution sections

cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com.role: all imagery: page heroes, product-page artwork, 50 pricing-hub icons, free-services artwork, geographies and support imagery, 142 story header images and company logos, 21 blog card images, 86 dictionary article heroes
cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com.note: identical artwork served by the CDN for multiple pages is stored once and referenced by every page that uses it (24 duplicate groups collapsed to canonical files); one story header (27016 Muleshoe Area Medical Center) returns HTTP 403 on the CDN and is rendered without a header image; the header logo comes from uhf.microsoft.com

content.note: every content record in source_data/*.json is derived from the real captures above; nothing is invented

benchmark_users.note: the four benchmark accounts (alice.chen/bob.alvarez/carol.ito/dana.osei @test.com, password TestPass123!) follow the shared WebHarbor benchmark-user convention (frozen bcrypt hash so the seed DB stays byte-reproducible); they are account-surface infrastructure, not upstream content

images.note: all 515 images under static/images/ were downloaded from the upstream CDNs; asset_inventory.json records per-file sha256, bytes and the exact source URL, and scripts/check_asset_inventory.py enforces exact coverage, hash integrity and real format headers at image build time

determinism.seed: the SQLite seed is materialized at image build time (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, no wall clock, no RNG in any seed row; estimate/favorite timestamps are runtime data, not seed data) and is byte-identical across resets
determinism.transforms: scripts_dev/build_source_data.py converts the raw captures in scraped_data/ (gitignored) into the tracked source_data/*.json byte-reproducibly
